close_reason: Decision recorded: Vec<Id> by value in async trait is correct
description: parse_mdns takes blob_ids: Vec<jmap_types::Id> by value. A reviewer might suggest &[Id]. Taking &[Id] in an async-trait-like RPITIT (impl Future + Send) is problematic: the returned future would capture the reference, requiring explicit lifetime bounds on the trait. Owned Vec<Id> avoids this. The design is correct for async Rust. Do not change to &[Id] without careful lifetime analysis.
title: MdnBackend::parse_mdns receives Vec<Id> by value — consistent with async trait, correct
